download_url: download a file from a URL to a local directory with automatic https to http fallback
get_dataset_names_from_task: get dataset names from a list of editing task categories like clarity or fluency
get_dataset_category: get the editing category for a dataset name like jfleg or wnc
transpose_dict: convert a dictionary of lists into a list of dictionaries with matching keys
print_metric_report: print a metric scores report as markdown or tsv with average scores per metric
